title: Whac-A-Mole
shortDescription: Whac-A-Mole is included in GameAtlas's Nintendo DS family arcade route, alongside deterministic catalog context and a linked Wikidata item.
highlights: Sets a direct-reference arcade marker within the Nintendo DS family catalog.
Labels the source relationship without treating it as a popularity signal.

signals.label: GameAtlas catalog method
signals.rationale: Indexed for the Nintendo DS family arcade discovery path using a Wikidata-listed catalog relationship; this remains a catalog record, never an aggregate score.
